verdict.rationale: Retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a hosted document-processing API, so the axis applies. The pack never documents retention windows, file-deletion endpoints, zero-data-retention options or user-facing deletion controls. The on-prem and single-container deployment claims concern data residency and sovereignty, which is an adjacent capability, not retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
